title: dlp_api_server.py: bad input, gate order, headers, jobs, downloads, credential chain, merge leftovers
standards: OWASP Top 10 2021 A01 A03 A04 A05 A07

checks.what: Malformed JSON, wrong types, NaN/Infinity, oversized, unexpected and nested fields on all 277 routes, with the sample tenant signed in (5 fuzz passes, 0 5xx at the end)
Errors are JSON with a detail, bounded, no traceback, request body or secret
5xx details name no server folder
Every /api route without the UI token is a 401 before any handler or sign-in
Every POST with a foreign Origin is a 403 before scope or sign-in
With the token gate off, a non-loopback Host (DNS rebinding) is a 403
No POST route signs in with nothing in scope, except the documented exemptions
Every write route refuses before sign-in with write mode off, no confirmation or no assessor
CSP, nosniff and X-Frame-Options DENY on every page and JSON answer, the 500, 429, 401 and preflight answers included
The body cap's 413 carries the hardening headers
A job is stopped only by its starter (SSO); unknown starter stays stoppable
A Stop sent before its start answered makes the job start cancelled
Job, pending-stop, HAR batch, Test a list and plan stores are bounded
stop-before-start honours the job's starter
Every Content-Disposition name is a constant, stamp or sanitised part; traversal, quote, CR/LF and non-Latin-1 ids are 4xx on every download route
Body, then profile, then environment, then tenant_config.json
A stored secret is only sent with its own tenant's identity
Single, start, batch, host, export and identities with IDN, IPv6, URLs, CIDR, odd ports and protocols
A bare IPv6 destination is analysed
Start, poll, export (csv/xlsx, rows filters), list, fix and fix hand-off with odd inputs
pyflakes: no undefined or redefined names; symtable: every implicit global exists; UI-called /api paths all exist
No route registered twice, no top-level def or class defined twice, no unreachable statement, no unused helper
Report temp files are created by NamedTemporaryFile/mkstemp (0600) and removed after sending

findings.title: Non-JSON NaN/Infinity literals in a body reached handlers (int(NaN) in the HAR batch was a 500)
findings.fix: Every route decodes bodies as strict RFC 8259 JSON (_StrictJSONRoute); NaN/Infinity is a 422/400 before any handler

findings.title: 500, 429 and CORS preflight answers carried no CSP, nosniff or frame denial
findings.fix: SecurityHeadersMiddleware sits just inside the body cap (outside the rate limiter, CORS and the UI token gate); the unhandled-error 500 sets the same headers itself (commits cb3d1b3 and d1fc71f)

findings.title: A saved profile's, the environment's or tenant_config.json's secret was paired with a typed vanity domain or client id of another tenant (the secret went to that tenant's sign-in host)
findings.fix: _same_sign_in: a stored sign-in fills blanks only when no typed vanity domain, client id or username names another tenant; otherwise fail closed with the missing field

findings.title: /api/live-feed trusted the page's running tally: a missing or non-numeric counter was a KeyError/TypeError 500, extra keys were echoed back
findings.fix: _live_tally keeps the known counters as bounded whole numbers and drops everything else

findings.title: Under SSO, any signed-in person could stop another person's running deploy or removal by job id
findings.fix: _require_job_owner: a job with a known starter is stopped only by that person (no change without SSO)

findings.title: 5xx details quoting an exception named absolute server folders (app, Python, temp, home)
findings.fix: The HTTPException handler names each server folder by its role in every 5xx detail

findings.title: HAR batch: schemes/methods that are not lists were a TypeError 500, and methods "GET" was read as G, E, T
findings.fix: Only lists are read (at most 100 items); anything else names no method or scheme

findings.title: /api/migrate/optimize, /upload and /post passed rule rows unchecked: a non-text name, state or action was an AttributeError 500
findings.fix: _rule_text_fields (shared with the hand-read routes' _rule_rows) refuses with a 400 naming the field before sign-in

findings.title: Evaluate All optimiser exceptions of the wrong shape (pinned list, text position, numeric skip list) were 500s
/api/posture/analyze and /project: a check row's section or channel that was a list or object was an unhashable TypeError 500
findings.fix: _posture_checks reads sec, section and channel as bounded text and out_of_scope as a boolean

findings.title: /api/migrate/reorder: a list or object order token, or a rule named by a list, was an unhashable TypeError 500
findings.fix: Order tokens must be text or numbers and rule names text (400)

findings.title: path_analyzer.parse_destination rejects a bare IPv6 literal (2001:db8::1, ::1): one IPv6 row (bracketed or a v6 CIDR, which bulk_test expands to bare addresses) fails the whole Test a list job, a bare IPv6 HAR host is skipped and the single analyzer answers 400
findings.fix: Bracket a bare IPv6 literal before urlsplit in path_analyzer.parse_destination (outside dlp_api_server.py)
findings.test: proposed: tests/test_path_analyzer.py — parse_destination('2001:db8::1')['host'] == '2001:db8::1'; POST /api/bulk-test/start with '[2001:db8::1]:443' finishes done
findings.proposed_patch:
--- a/path_analyzer.py
+++ b/path_analyzer.py
@@ -69,7 +69,11 @@
     raw = (text or "").strip()
     if not raw:
         raise ValueError("Enter a URL, a hostname or an IP address.")
-    s = raw if re.match(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://", raw, re.I) else "https://" + raw
+    try:   # a bare IPv6 literal (2001:db8::1, ::1) is an address, not host:port
+        raw_v6 = ipaddress.IPv6Address(raw.split("%", 1)[0])
+    except ValueError:
+        raw_v6 = None
+    s = raw if re.match(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://", raw, re.I) else "https://" + (f"[{raw_v6.compressed}]" if raw_v6 else raw)
     try:
         u = urlsplit(s)
         host = (u.hostname or "").lower().strip(".")

findings.title: POST /api/dlp-packs/jobs/stop-before-start cancels a job that already exists for the start token whoever started it (SSO: one person can stop another's run if they hold its start token)
findings.fix: pack_jobs.stop_before_start(token, actor) refuses (PermissionError -> 403) when the job's known starter is someone else; the route passes _actor(request)
findings.proposed_patch:

+++ b/pack_jobs.py
@@ -153,10 +153,12 @@
             del _token_jobs[k]
 
 
-def stop_before_start(token: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+def stop_before_start(token: Any, actor: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
     """Stop for a run whose start request has not answered yet. When its
     job already exists it is cancelled now; otherwise the stop waits for
-    the job, which then starts stopped. Returns what was done."""
+    the job, which then starts stopped. Returns what was done.
+    PermissionError when the job exists and was started by someone else
+    (`actor` given and the job's actor known and different)."""
     t = valid_start_token(token)
     if t is None:
         raise ValueError("start_token must be 8-64 letters, digits, '-' or '_'.")
@@ -170,6 +172,9 @@
                 del _pending_stops[oldest]
             _pending_stops[t] = now
     if job_id is not None:
+        job = get(job_id)
+        if actor is not None and job is not None and job.actor and job.actor != actor:

         return {"job_id": job_id, "cancelled": cancel(job_id), "pending": False}
     return {"job_id": None, "cancelled": True, "pending": True}

findings.title: The body cap's 413 (security.BodySizeLimitMiddleware, the outermost layer by design) carries no CSP, nosniff or frame denial
findings.fix: BodySizeLimitMiddleware._too_large sets the hardening headers on its own refusal (security.py, outside dlp_api_server.py)
findings.test: proposed: tests/test_c6_api_server.py — a body one byte over the cap is a 413 with nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY and CSP
findings.proposed_patch:
--- a/security.py
+++ b/security.py
@@ -520,7 +520,10 @@
                           client=str(client[0]), bytes=size, limit=self.max_bytes)
         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — logging never blocks the refusal
             pass
-        return JSONResponse({"detail": f"Request body too large (max {self.max_bytes} bytes)."}, status_code=413)
+        # Outside the headers layer too: the refusal carries the same hardening headers itself.
+        return JSONResponse({"detail": f"Request body too large (max {self.max_bytes} bytes)."}, status_code=413,
+                            headers={"X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff", "X-Frame-Options": "DENY", "Referrer-Policy": "no-referrer",
+                                     "Content-Security-Policy": CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY, "Cache-Control": "no-store"})
 
     async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send):

findings.title: Local names shadow route functions (digests_list's `health`, flow_scenario's `import dlp_efficacy`); local scope only, behaviour correct
findings.fix: Accepted: no rename (renaming risks the response code paths for no behaviour change)

findings.title: /api/checks and /api/checks/export with an unknown scope list the whole static catalog
findings.fix: Accepted: the catalog is static and public to the UI; no tenant is read

findings.title: /api/dlp-packs/journey, /baseline-status and /api/remediation/execute sign in without a Scope page selection
findings.fix: Accepted: documented exemptions in tests/test_scope_rule_routes.py EXEMPT (an operator-picked pack or check)
